steps.command:
sbx run <<'EOF'
ls -la /workspace
echo "---"
cat /workspace/portfolio_baseline.py
echo "---SETUP---"
cat /workspace/setup.py
echo "---C---"
cat /workspace/portfolio_optimized.c
echo "---PY---"
cat /workspace/portfolio_optimized.py
echo "---BENCH---"
cat /workspace/benchmark.py
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from portfolio_baseline import generate_test_data, portfolio_risk_python, portfolio_return_python
from portfolio_optimized import portfolio_risk_c, portfolio_return_c
for n in (1, 2, 10, 50, 200):
    w, cov, r = generate_test_data(n)
    wr, covr, rr = portfolio_risk_python(w, cov), None, portfolio_return_python(w, r)
    # lists
    assert abs(portfolio_risk_c(w, cov) - wr) < 1e-10
    assert abs(portfolio_return_c(w, r) - rr) < 1e-10
    # numpy inputs
    wn, covn, rn = np.array(w), np.array(cov), np.array(r)
    assert abs(portfolio_risk_c(wn, covn) - wr) < 1e-10
    assert abs(portfolio_return_c(wn, rn) - rr) < 1e-10
    # non-contiguous 2D array
    big = np.zeros((n, 2*n))
    big[:, ::2] = covn
    nc = big[:, ::2]
    assert abs(portfolio_risk_c(wn, nc) - wr) < 1e-10
print("all extra checks passed")
PY
